status: Concrete controller expectations fixed before any compiler feedback on these new consumers. Generic I/O and earlier certificate checks are prior evidence only.

fixed_data_before_raw.parameters: K, Γ, Λ, R and all finite instances; caller and initial
fixed_data_before_raw.blank: (false, fun _ => none), the existing Γ′ blank
fixed_data_before_raw.source_default: Package.controlInhabited from actual package main and initialRegisters initial
fixed_data_before_raw.bit: MarkedInput.symbol at actual package input index; no whole-word encoder
fixed_data_before_raw.machine: ordinaryMachine caller initial, fixed before raw

ordinary_bound.meaning: Uniform upper bound to live stopped singleton output, never asserted as exact runtime
ordinary_bound.outer_none: One additional native transition, uniform bound T_A(N)+1
ordinary_bound.witness_preservation: Widen only steps_le_m; retain original toEvalsTo and literal steps

input_output_expectations.all_raw_words: Every finite Boolean word, including malformed framing
input_output_expectations.empty_and_present_false: Distinct complete native input tapes, distinct because none and some false differ
input_output_expectations.letters: Both Boolean letters are nonblank and injection is injective
input_output_expectations.output: Full Tape.mk₁ singleton of ordinary bit at live done; actual next step none; native eval singleton retained
input_output_expectations.indices: Actual input and fuel indices remain distinct
input_output_expectations.true_initial_fixture: Boolean caller register initial=true remains true in the supported source default and in the actual prelude run entry; wrapper start itself remains start

pair_and_witness_expectations.existing_codec_only: BitPairFraming.frame input cert = escapeBits input ++ true :: cert
pair_and_witness_expectations.all_pair_allowance: 2*(input.length + cert.length + 1), using the existing checked frame_length_le_combined
pair_and_witness_expectations.all_pair_polynomial: ordinaryTimePolynomial A composed with 2*(X+1), evaluated at input.length+cert.length; no certificate-size premise
pair_and_witness_expectations.small_certificate: For BinaryYes input, the existing actual certificate has cert.length ≤ input.length^2
pair_and_witness_expectations.threshold: Literal bs and its width retained; no canonicalization or unary replacement
pair_and_witness_expectations.semantics: Concrete rotation consumer only; generic raw decider does not import rotation or duplicate codec
